# Dependencies

Lua 5.1.5: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.1.5.tar.gz
Original sources; license in lua-5.1.5/COPYRIGHT (MIT).

stb_truetype.h: https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/master/stb_truetype.h
Original header; MIT/public-domain license included at the end of the file.

The runtime does not link the game's Android, Steam, SDL or FMOD binaries.

dr_mp3.h: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs/blob/master/dr_mp3.h
Original header; MIT-0/public-domain license included at the end of the file.

## English

Lua 5.1.5, stb_truetype, dr_mp3 and libvita2d-core retain their included upstream licenses. See `libvita2d-core/UPSTREAM.md` for provenance and local changes. The LuaJIT 00.78 variant uses external local dependencies described in [BUILDING](../docs/BUILDING.md#english). Commercial game data is not included.
